liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the most inspired Franklin's Tower in the band's history [14]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): The performance of Wharf Rat wowed the listener [7]

## The recordings

- **gd76-06-17.sony.vernon.10178.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 189 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1976-06-17.163393.aud.unknown.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 174 min [2]. Said about its sound: Some level fluctuations occur for the first few minutes of Cold Rain & Snow [2]
- **gd1976-06-17.sbd.miller.80739.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard mix features Keith well in the mix, with great vocals and clean sound; Drums are immense, clean sounding, and feature a complex snare pattern [11][15]
- **gd1976-06-17.mtx.seamons.91861.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 198 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [5]. Said about its sound: Matrix mixdown is described as clean, crisp, and well balanced; Reviewer calls this the sweetest recording on the site, with the band rocking hard [12][18]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls attending as a new high school graduate on this special night [7]
- Bobby's first catcall occurred during this song, starting a new Grateful Dead tradition [10]
- Reviewer claims Scarlet Begonias and The Music Never Stopped were not played [8]
- Reviewer rates this show as a solid four-star performance, similar to the Boston show [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-06-17.sony.vernon.10178.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Recorded on Sony TC 153 with ECM 99A mics; transferred by Dale Shepherd [1]
- **gd1976-06-17.163393.aud.unknown.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes (unknown mics/deck); Bob Wagner's 1st generation cassettes [2]
- **gd1976-06-17.sbd.miller.80739.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) D [4]. Also: Soundboard recording is seamless with no audible disc changes [4]
- **gd1976-06-17.mtx.seamons.91861.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: MATRIX MIX: SBD/AUD (About 60%/40%) [5]. Also: Hunter Seamons spliced sources into a matrix that breathes with new life; Matrix created by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro; show is seamless [5][13]
